title: fix(plugin-chatbot,app-shell): keep an assistant answer's chart after a reload
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8HgycqL368Q1SBpG5BAa6AZ)_
Fixes #25908

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:AI 助手回答里的图表,刷新页面后不再消失;从服务器历史和本地缓存恢复时都会按原位置画回来。
- 为什么改:直播流里的图表是一次性的,服务器不存它;服务器存的是 `visualize_data` 工具结果,里面的 `chart` 字段就是同一份图表描述,之前没人读它。
- 风险与回滚:只影响聊天消息的恢复路径;没有 `chart` 字段的旧结果照旧不画图;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/mapMessages.ts`(唯一读 `chart` 的地方与防重复画图规则)、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useChatConversation.ts`(缓存写法)、`ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/useObjectChat.ts`(API 模式重建)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/mapMessages.persistedChart-25908.test.ts packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/useObjectChat.persistedChart-25908.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/__tests__/AiChatPage.persistedChart-25908.test.ts`,预期三个文件全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

An assistant answer that drew a chart came back as text only after a reload. The live stream draws the chart from a transient `data-chart` part that the server never stores. What the server stores is the `visualize_data` tool result, one JSON string whose `chart` key holds the same descriptor the part carried (#26744, comment 6457382770). Nothing read that key back.

- **One reader** (`plugin-chatbot` `mapMessages.ts`, `chartFromToolResult`). It reads `chart` off a `visualize_data` result through the existing `parseResultEnvelope`, and narrows it with the same `chartFromDescriptor` the `data-chart` part goes through, now shared by both. The top-level `rows` (a 20-row narration preview) are never drawn. A result stored before the producer wrote `chart` gives no chart, with no rebuild from its other keys.
- **Where it sits.** `extractCharts` reads tool results only for a message that has no `data-chart` part. A live message carries both, so it still draws the chart once. A stored message carries only the result, so each chart takes the offset of its tool part among the text parts.
- **Hydration** (`app-shell` `hydratedMessagesToChatMessages`) sets `charts` from `chartsFromParts(message.parts)`. That walk covers both the server's `visualize_data` results and the cache's `data-chart` parts, and the offsets index the same text join the hydration makes `content`. The share page (`SharedRecordPage`) renders these messages directly, so it gets the chart too, with no change to its file.
- **API-mode round trip** (`useObjectChat` `aiInitialMessages`). The rebuild used to write one text part and then the tools, so a hydrated `charts` key was dropped. It now writes `chartAnswerParts(content, charts)`: the text cut at each chart's offset, with a `data-chart` part between the runs. The mapper reads that back as the same content and the same charts at the same offsets.
- **Cache** (`app-shell` `sanitizeChatMessagesForCache`). It writes the same `chartAnswerParts` in place of the single text part, so a cache-fallback reload keeps the chart and its place. A tool-output arm would not have kept the place, because a tool part carries no position in the cache.
- **Where the fix sits, and why.** The order offered two places: the rebuild emits `data-chart` parts, or `mapMessages` re-derives charts from the tool output. This PR takes the first for the round trip and the cache, because the live path already draws from `data-chart` parts and only position-encoded parts keep `textOffset` through a rebuild that joins text. The one reader of `chart` sits in `mapMessages`, and the hydration mapper reaches it through `chartsFromParts`.
- **Tool name.** `@objectstack/spec` declares `visualize_data` only as a member of `PLATFORM_TOOLS_BY_PACKAGE['service-ai']`, with no constant of its own. `mapMessages` keeps one literal, `VISUALIZE_DATA_TOOL` (a module export, not a package export), and a test pins it to that registry.
- **New exports** (`Clause-②: yes (widening)`, claim 6487631480): `chartsFromParts`, `chartAnswerParts` and the `ChartAnswerPart` type, on `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot` and `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot/core`. app-shell is private and needs to call the one reader, so these exports are how it does.

## Tests

- `plugin-chatbot` `mapMessages.persistedChart-25908.test.ts`. A stored result yields the same chart the live part draws (title, series labels, all 30 rows rather than the 20-row preview), at the offset of its tool part. A bare string result is read too. A result without `chart` gives no chart and does not throw, and neither does a non-JSON one. Only `visualize_data` is read, and its name is pinned to the spec registry. A live message with both the part and the result draws one chart. `chartAnswerParts` maps back to the same message, and a chart without an offset follows the text.
- `plugin-chatbot` `useObjectChat.persistedChart-25908.test.tsx`. In API mode, a hydrated answer keeps one chart at its offset through the store, and the bubble draws it once, between the two text runs.
- `app-shell` `AiChatPage.persistedChart-25908.test.ts`. Server history restores the chart between the text it sat between, and a result without `chart` restores text and tool with no chart. A live answer is cached and restored with its chart in place, and a restored server answer survives being cached again.

## Acceptance notes

- The reach has never been measured in a running console, and the producer change (cloud `abffd69`) runs on hosted deploys only (`@objectstack/service-ai` 10.3.0 on npm predates it). The proof here is fixture-level, against the result shape #26744 read on cloud `main` `a32c80c`.
- The fixtures use the AI SDK text output wrapper (`{ type: 'text', value }`), the form a string tool result takes, and a bare string. A JSON-wrapped output (`{ type: 'json', value }`) with no `status` key resolves to the wrapper in the shared `parseResultEnvelope`, so it would give no chart. The producer returns a string, so that shape is not reached, and this PR does not change the shared parser.
- Local mode (no `api`) keeps dropping hydrated render-only keys in `normalizeMessages`, `charts` and `buildProgress` alike, as before. AiChatPage runs local mode only with no chat backend, which has no stored conversations.
